messages:
leo: Heads-up: planning a nodal maintenance window tonight 02:00-03:30 UTC. Targeting pool 'saturn-gpu-3' for a graceful drain + NIC egress shift. Expected 20% capacity loss for ~45-60m while we juggle traffic. Requesting canary + fallback plan.
maria: ETA on when routing policy will flip? need to size burst capacity and cost estimate.
aj: We'll avoid full global failover — routing will shift by policy to regional spare pools, then to quantized variants if region saturated. Can we reserve 2 racks for burst?
leo: yes, reserving 2 racks as warm backfill. cost tradeoff: reserving racks vs. serving slightly slower quantized models.
devops: playbook snippet:```kubectl cordon node-xyz && kubectl drain node-xyz --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120``` do not run in parallel >2 nodes, use cohort id tag.
sre-oncall: canary plan: drain 1 node first, watch p95 latency and failed requests for 15m, then proceed with cohort. seed KV cache on backfill nodes before traffic.
maria: note — if KV seed fails we should fallback to hosted-route tier to avoid tenant-visible tail latency. who's owning fallback runbook?
aj: I'll own fallback runbook. sequence: (1) cohort drain, (2) warmbackfill + kv-seed, (3) shift routing, (4) monitor. If p95 > 250ms or error rate +20% -> abort and revert.
ops-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance ticket INF-4729 created and linked to status page. Pinged #customer-comm for notifications. :rotating_light:
leo: thanks — action items: aj owns runbook+fallback, devops to coordinate cordon commands and limit parallelism, sre-oncall to run canary checks & metrics, maria to prepare cost delta calc for reserved racks vs quantized routing. Update status page once schedule is locked. :thumbsup:
maria: quick ask — can we get a rough $/hour delta for 2 reserved racks? need to flag finance if >$X.
aj: rough guesstimate: +$180/hr for 2 racks (GPU-backed), but quantized variant overhead ~+10% latency, -35% cost per-token. will run detailed calc and post before EOD.
sre-oncall: also adding perf check list: KV hitrate, batch sizes, token-per-second, p50/p95/p99. I'll attach dashboards post-canary.
leo: ok all, we'll start with the single-node canary at 02:00 UTC. keep chat active during ops window. if anyone cannot attend, DM me.
ops-bot: Deploy bot: maintenance window locked: 2026-03-22T02:00Z — participation checklist created.
leo: 👍
